QuestInfo.name: [Fight for Azwan] Hard Mode
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Longorias about the Fight for Azwan.
QuestInfo.1:
Enter the Fight for Azwan in Hard Mode. Destroy the #rGuardian Tower#k in #bAttack Mode#k or #bOccupation Mode#k and destroy the #rMega Ballista#k in #bDefense Mode#k.

Hard Mode Guardian Tower #r#a39671##k
Hard Mode Mega Ballista #r#a39672##k

#rTip : Can be done once a day

0.0: You've got some skills, but being a good fighter won't get you through Hard Mode. You'll have to show cunning and patience.
0.1: Destroy the #rGuardian Tower#k in #bAttack Mode#k or #Occupation mode#k and destroy the #rMega Ballista#k in Defense Mode. We need them both destroyed if we're going to make any headway.

1.0: If only we had a hundred more warriors of your strength...

mob.0: Destroy the #rGuardian Tower#k in #bAttack Mode#k or #bOccupation Mode#k and destroy the #rMega Ballista#k in #bDefense Mode#k.
